en.text:
Finishing a reload within 3.6 seconds of scoring 1|2|3 Weapon Kills within 3.5 seconds of each grants 17%|33%|50% increased damage for #e${5+#d} seconds.

Buff is overwritten every time it is triggered and is removed on stow.

enhanced (
var d = 0.5
#e Buff Duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.
)
